events.title: Steam Next Fest | DeepSpaceSurvivor:EndlessStarfield Demo Gameplay Showcase
events.summary: Welcome to the Steam Next Fest gameplay showcase for DeepSpaceSurvivor:EndlessStarfield!Pilot your ship through dangerous star systems in this sci-fi survivors-like. Gather resources, craft and upgrade weapons, and build your own arsenal as swarms of enemies close in.Join this livestream for a look at the demo's space combat, resource gathering, and weapon progression. Play the demo for free now, and if you enjoy this deep-space adventure, add the game to your wishlist!

events.title: 🚀 The Demo is Available Now!
events.summary: Hello everyone!After several months of development (and a final sprint over the past few weeks), I'm excited to announce that the Deep Space Survivor: EndlessStarfield Demo is now available on Steam!In the current demo, you can experience:🚀 Fast-paced Bullet Heaven combat⚡ Two powerful Super Weapons⛏️ Mine rare space minerals to strengthen your ship👾 Fight through endless enemy fleets in deep space🌌 Explore three playable star systemThis is only the beginning.I'm actively working on new content
